shortDescription: MEXICO CITY, Sep 11 (Reuters) - Mexican industrial output rose 0.5 percent in July from June and was 2.7 percent higher year-over-year, the national statistics agency said on Friday.((Mexico City newsroom, +52 55 5282-7153, mexicocity.newsroom@reuters.com))
